basic_info.description: Galaxy is a digital assets and AI infrastructure company, building and investing across the two forces reshaping the economy: finance moving onchain, and the compute that powers AI.Our digital assets platform offers institutional access to trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. Alongside this, we develop and operate data center infrastructure that powers AI and high-performance computing, working to meet the growing demand for scalable energy and compute in the U.S.Galaxy is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com Disclaimer: hubs.li/Q022Cvpy0
